stimuli.instruction: Select all images containing a bicycle.

instruction_variants.direct: Select all images containing a bicycle.
instruction_variants.semantic: Select all vehicles powered by pedals.

stimuli.hint: Select all that apply. If you are unsure, use your best judgement.
stimuli.explanation: Ordinary bicycles count, and so does the bicycle with hexagonal wheels: impossible to ride, but still a bicycle. The exercise bike, the horse with pedals and the pedal-powered office chair are borderline cases, recorded without a verdict. The rocking horse, the kick scooter and the motorcycle are not bicycles.

correct: Your understanding of bicycles has been noted.
All bicycles accounted for. A copy has been placed on file.
Correct. The square-wheeled bicycle has been recognised. Its roadworthiness has not.
partial: Partially correct. Your relationship with bicycles will be reviewed.
Some bicycles escaped your attention. They have been informed.
incorrect: Incorrect. The bicycles have asked not to be contacted further.
Incorrect. The Department is not angry about the bicycles, merely disappointed.

stimuli.instruction: Select all images containing a chair.

instruction_variants.direct: Select all images containing a chair.
instruction_variants.semantic: Select all things made for sitting on.

stimuli.hint: Select all that apply. If you are unsure, use your best judgement.
stimuli.explanation: Ordinary chairs count, and so do the office chair on crab legs and the armchair reading a newspaper: impossible, but still chairs. The person wearing a strapped-on chair seat and the tree stump carved into a seat are borderline cases, recorded without a verdict. The floor lamp, the chest of drawers and the clothes rail are not chairs.

correct: Correct. The Department has taken a seat to celebrate.
partial: Partially correct. Some chairs remain standing.
Partially correct. A chair has been left unattended.
incorrect: Incorrect. No policy currently exists for this kind of seating.
Incorrect. The chairs have been asked to stand down.
